e915d142a54fdad173662822c32679d7e075857d.summary: Group-IB analysis of the Corkow (Metel) Trojan and its attacks on trading and bank card systems. In February 2015 Corkow gave hackers remote access to a bank's trading terminal; seven trades over 14 minutes caused exchange-rate volatility and losses in the millions. In August 2015 the same Trojan was linked to an attack on bank card systems in which hundreds of millions of rubles were stolen via ATMs. The report says the botnet reached over 250 000 devices and spread via drive-by downloads using the Nitris exploit kit. Russian-speaking hackers are believed responsible, and no secret services…
